svg.text: Label facing you, label readable, contacts down — left to right: pin 1 → pin 32 (GND confirmed far right)
(contacts are on the back of the PCB — shown as seen through the shell)
AD0–AD15 (ROM addr lo + 16-bit data / SRAM addr)
Saves: SRAM/Flash → /CS2 (30). EEPROM → /CS (5), /RD, /WR, AD0 (6), A23 (29). RTC IRQ → /REQ (31). GPIO/RTC lines live on the ROM chip, not the edge. No audio pin in GBA mode.
Viewed from the contact side the order mirrors: pin 32 (GND) at left … pin 1 (VDD) at right. Signals per GBATEK / ConsoleMods; orientation confirmed by continuity test (GND far right).
